name: Kalyani ka Sach
synopsis: Kalyani, a schoolteacher in a Rohtak village, finds a letter that proves her late father's land was never sold. Her brother-in-law Randhir has built his standing on that sale. Her husband must choose between his wife and his family, and the panchayat is watching.

name: Dhola Maru Returns
synopsis: A modern retelling in Jaisalmer. Dhola, a folk singer, returns after eight years to find Maru engaged to a hotel owner. A wedding, a flooded stepwell, and a song that only two people know.
